about_the_game:
Enter a cooperative nightmare for 1 to 5 players, where survival depends on quick thinking and true teamwork. Trapped inside a vast labyrinthine hotel, you are relentlessly hunted by a towering teddy bear. Among countless doors, only one hides the firearm that can turn the tide—if you manage to find it before it’s too late.

Hide, run, explore, and combine strategies to delay the inevitable. The threat never stops, and only coordination and collective intelligence can keep you alive.

With its unsettling minimalist style—a disturbing mix of cartoon and realism—the game amplifies fear through eerie lighting, tense soundscapes, sudden action, and thunderous gunfire. An immersive horror experience where every choice matters, and terror is best faced together.
